observations: Current district including Architecture and Market contains 52 meshes / 60792 triangles before heroes and FX; initial graybox was 221 meshes / 2652 triangles.
Native Godot 4.7 OpenGL llvmpipe capture produced 18 images without render errors; current geometry uses batched architectural and market detail.
Newest selected separate bazaar strips govern architecture, palette and rendering. Older city/market panoramas are historical style drafts.
Solid blocks, ramps, bridge, passage, structural roof and balcony details, market props and street anchors use actual world collision.
All human art and deployment approvals remain pending.
corrections: Route approach waypoints now avoid ramp side faces.
City ground snapping only applies to grounded locomotion.
Angled rope reeling pulls toward anchor; steeper rope reeling lifts without walking.
Ramp winding and flat normals corrected after native inspection revealed invisible top faces.
Monochrome actual-geometry plan uses unshaded height categories to avoid clipped whites.
Flattened indexed primitives before batching with authored cloth and roof triangles; geometry checks assert authored/rendered triangle parity.
Replaced overlapping mansard slabs with closed trapezoid roofs and matching convex collision.
Changed upper windows to rectangular shapes and added shutters, muted the palette, paved traversal decks and aligned dome finial after reference review.
remainingRisks: Local modular style pass is implemented; hand-drawn linework refinement, final dressing and full-city expansion remain open
